The test image shows sugarcane plants with severely browned/dried leaves, white/cream longitudinal streaks along the leaf blades, and a darkened/rotted base. Key features: browning from tips down, pale longitudinal streaking, blackened crown area.

Top candidates: **Leaf_Scald** (pencil-line white streaks + leaf browning) or **Sett_Rot** (base rotting + plant death).

Viewing a Leaf_Scald reference to confirm the streaking pattern:

The Leaf_Scald reference shows a distinct white/cream pencil-line streak on a green leaf. The test image has some white/pale longitudinal streaking but is dominated by severe overall browning of all leaves and a blackened rotted base/crown area — consistent with whole-plant death from root/base rot rather than the streak-then-browning progression of Leaf_Scald.

The blackened crown base + all leaves dying together points more strongly to **Sett_Rot**, where the sett (base/seed piece) rots causing complete plant collapse with all leaves browning and dying simultaneously.
